stageNotes: Stage 1 — Canonical: both apex and www return HTTP 200; no canonical link tag; apex chosen as canonical (preserves input intent)

Stage 2 — WAF: Sucuri active (rule-selective on SQLi/XSS + honeypot); rapid-burst all 200; iPhone UA used; sustained 50-page walk NOT performed (only 104 total products — sustained-burst test impractical for site size)
Stage 3 — Platform: no generator meta; no WC/Shopify/BC/Magento/Drupal markers; custom PHP with .php URLs and PHPSESSID cookie; persona designates adapterType=generic-retail

Stage 4 — Catalog: bare /product.php returns the full 104-product catalog server-rendered; narrow departments cover 99/104; departments=Firearms/=Import_/_Export/=Featured aliases-fall-back to no-filter (same 104); chose bare URL as the single 100%-coverage catalogUrl
Stage 5 — Pagination: ?page=2 returns identical product set (104 IDs, 0 new IDs vs page=1); jPages client-side pagination confirmed via /js/pagination.js; paginationPattern.type=null per Mistake 15

Stage 6 — Sort: no <select name=sort|order|orderby> in catalog HTML; DOM order on bare /product.php is not alphabetical (henry-... before armscor-...); persona Mistake 18 cross-referenced DOM first product against POST endpoint baseline and confirmed p.id DESC; sortParam='' (path-baked / natural DOM); sortVerified=true accepts the persona claim

Stage 7 — Watermark: navigate-from-watermark; whole catalog renders in one page so the 'find-then-index' phase is trivial — single GET, compare productIds against stored lastSeenIds; reason field captures the rationale

Stage 8 — Count: html-pagination via .showing_result selector; selector value 'Showing 104 result' parsed; perPage=1 multiplier (the selector returns the literal full count, not a last-page number times perPage). NOTE: runtime html-pagination probe may expect an anchor selector with a numeric last-page href — runtime compatibility should be verified before promotion

Stage 9 — Final assembly: validator-required fields all populated; one URL in catalogUrls covers 100% of products; ageGate=false; needsPlaywright=false; userAgentOverride retained as iPhone Safari for Sucuri-resilience
